title: The 2000s & 2010s Mixed Music Quiz
subtitle: Twenty on the decades, ten to name from the intro
notes: Written 22 September 2026 for the Station Tap. No image round: a picture question cannot exist without its file and the only drawn artwork is the eleven 2000s portraits already used by the 2000-2010 pack. The intro cues carry no spotifyUri yet — run scripts/recue-all.mjs on a machine with Spotify credentials and commit, or play them off the DJ app.

questions.prompt: Which band released 'Original Pirate Material' in 2002?
